decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern or western walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The proposed and existing roof lights shall be fitted flush with the plane of the roof and should be of a conservation, velux style.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and rooflight to front elevation of the house
